title: Why Claude Code Is Probably Not an Agent
speaker: Misha Kolesnik
summary: Misha Kolesnik builds an agent up layer by layer from a bare LLM API, and argues orchestration is what separates an agent from a function call.
takeaways: An LLM API plus sessions can remember what it said. Still not an agent
You will never build enough tools, so let the agent build its own
Claude Code took off by handing the agent simple bash tools
OpenClaw is an agent; Claude Code and Codex probably aren't. They finish and die
Every piece is swappable and must evolve in isolation, as in Anthropic's Managed Agents design
